messages:
Samir: urgent escalation from NovaPay — customers seeing 429s and elevated latency on their dedicated pool (dedicated-nyc-prod-3). They reported sudden token bursts ~1.6k–2k TPS for ~90s, then sustained ~800 TPS. Billing shows burst credits drained. Can eng help with triage and immediate mitigations?
Linh: thanks Samir — putting on pager. which model and route are they using? any correlation with auth failures?
Samir: model: gptm-13b-q4 -- via /v1/generate route. Auth errors minimal, but some 401s when token refreshes coincided with peak. main symptom is admission controller returning 429s with "capacity_exceeded" and logs showing "burst_quota=0".
Rafael: pinging eng-runtime. earliest hypothesis: admission token-bucket exhausted + autoscaler not fast enough due to cooldown. Pool is at 100% on 4 x A10G nodes. Autoscaler policy: scale_step=2, cooldown=120s, warm_start_time ~90s.
Priya: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) short-term increase pool headroom (manual capacity add), 2) bump burst pool quota for account, 3) apply per-customer soft-throttle at edge. Which option do we want to pursue now?
Miro: I can spin reserve instance set (reserve-2) to attach to dedicated-nyc-prod-3. ETA ~4m to route traffic. Also we can enable immediate fallback rule to route excess to hosted tier (costly but buys time): `route_override=hosted-fallback-us`
Jenna: NovaPay prefers no hosted fallback — compliance. They accepted a manual capacity add if it's quick. Samir, can you confirm billing approval?
Samir: finance approved temporary capacity increase for 1h. Please proceed.
Rafael: on it — adding 2 nodes now and reducing autoscaler cooldown to 30s for the pool. Command I ran: `infractl pool update dedicated-nyc-prod-3 --add-nodes 2 --autoscaler-cooldown 30s`
devops-bot: (system) Node add initiated: job_id=job-90742, expected_ready_in=260s
Linh: while nodes come up, we should capture a repro harness so SRE can replay burst and validate admission behavior. Suggested loadgen: `python tools/loadgen.py --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --concurrency 200 --rps 1600 --duration 120 --avg_tokens 32 --auth-file ./tokens/novapay.txt`
Priya: also log the admission controller metrics: `admission.reqs_allowed`, `admission.overflows`, `admission.burst_quota_remaining` and KV-cache hit-rate. Export window 10s.
Rafael: capturing metrics now. Early readout: admission.burst_quota_remaining drops to 0 at t+7s of the surge and `admission.overflows` spikes. Autoscaler reacts after ~70s, nodes ready at ~260s, so gap remains.
Miro: root cause summary candidate: aggressive client-side burst (1.6–2k TPS) that exceeds configured burst refill rate + conservative autoscaler cooldown -> tokens exhausted -> admission rejects contain client-level 429s. Noisy neighbor? current metrics show NovaPay contributed >85% of tokens during burst, so not classic noisy neighbor across tenants; it's tenant self-inflicted burst.
Samir: action items: (A) short-term: reserve nodes attached (Rafael/Miro) and temporarily increase account burst quota by +50% (Priya), (B) mid-term: reduce autoscaler cooldown and add predictive prewarm for known scheduled bursts, (C) longer term: introduce per-client burst budget smoothing and add client SDK guidance for rate shaping. Priya, Rafael, can you coordinate customer notification text?
Priya: drafting now. Will include repro steps, suggested client-side smoothing example (JS):
```
// naive leaky bucket
let tokens = 1000;
setInterval(() => { tokens = Math.min(tokens + 50, 1000); }, 1000);
function send(req) { if (tokens <= 0) return retryLater(); tokens -= req.estimatedTokens; actuallySend(req); }
```
Samir: perfect. Rafael — please attach logs and the loadgen replay link once done. Linh — once we validate with replay, let's propose admission parameter tweaks: increase refill_rate for 60s windows, and set per-tenant burst_cap proportional to committed throughput.
Rafael: pushing logs and Grafana replay dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/surge-replay/novapay-2424009876 — includes admission and autoscaler timelines. Also uploaded load test artifact: s3://redwood-support/novapay/replays/2424009876.tar.gz
Miro: manual capacity added and routing confirmed. devops-bot reports new nodes ready. We saw immediate drop in 429s after nodes attached and quota bump.
Jenna: NovaPay ops says errors subsided after ~8m. They want root-cause doc and recommended SLA configuration to avoid future incidents.
Samir: assigning root-cause writeup to eng-sre; will share a template and timeline. Closing loop: add scheduled prewarm hook for any customer announcing >500 TPS planned campaigns.
Linh: noted. I'll create a short runbook and add to support playbooks: name it "dedicated: tenant-burst-handling". Will include commands, mitigation steps, and sample client smoothing code.
Samir: thanks team — marking resolved for now. Will follow up with postmortem if anything else emerges. :white_check_mark:
